title: Memory cards
summary: Turn cards to match each word with its meaning.
description: A light game over words already met.

requirements.text: A memory lesson is made only of memory games: cards turned two at a time to match each word with its meaning.
A memory game has at most `memory.pairs-max` pairs; a lesson with more words plays several games.
A group of fewer than `memory.pairs-min` pairs is not played.

values.description: The fewest pairs a memory game or round is played with.
The most pairs in one memory game.
